findings.title: Migration crashes when `embed_category` is unset and inserts unnormalized hosts
findings.body: `execute("SELECT c.id FROM categories AS c INNER JOIN site_settings AS s ON s.value = c.name WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'")[0]['id']` directly indexes `[0]` on the `PG::Result` without checking whether any rows were returned. On any database where `embed_category` was never saved in `site_settings` or does not match an existing category name (as well as on line 15 if `uncategorized_category_id` is absent), `[0]` raises `IndexError: Index 0 is out of range` and aborts the migration. Additionally, line 25 inserts each host via raw SQL without stripping schemes (`https?://`) or paths (`/.*`) as `EmbeddableHost` does in `before_validation`, so migrated hosts that included a scheme or path will fail to match `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host`.

findings.title: Contents of `category_fabricator.rb` and `embeddable_host_fabricator.rb` are swapped
findings.body: `spec/fabricators/category_fabricator.rb` was overwritten with `Fabricator(:embeddable_host)` while `spec/fabricators/embeddable_host_fabricator.rb` contains `Fabricator(:category)` and the other category fabricators.

findings.title: `before_validation` raises `NoMethodError` on nil host and `record_for_host` fails on uppercase hosts or ports
findings.body: In `before_validation`, `self.host.sub!` is called without checking `self.host.present?`, raising `NoMethodError: undefined method 'sub!' for nil:NilClass` if `host` is `nil`. In addition, `self.record_for_host` queries `where("lower(host) = ?", host)` using `uri.host` without calling `.downcase` (so URLs with uppercase characters in the host will not match) and ignores `uri.port` even though the format validation on line 2 permits `:port` in stored `host` values.

findings.title: Saving a host with default category leaves `host.category` undefined and buffer uncommitted
findings.body: When creating a new `embeddable-host` without choosing a category, `this.get('categoryId')` is `null` and the server assigns `SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id` in the response payload. However, the `.then` callback runs `host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId')))`, which overwrites `host.category` with `undefined` instead of looking up `host.get('category_id')`. In addition, `save()` never resets/commits the `buffered` proxy, so if the server normalizes the `host` value (e.g. stripping `http://`), clicking edit again will show the stale unnormalized input.

findings.title: `expandable_first_post?` spec claims to test blank `embeddable_host` but only passes because `embed_truncate` is false
findings.body: `Topic#expandable_first_post?` no longer checks whether an `EmbeddableHost` exists, and the test `it "is false if embeddable_host is blank"` only passes because `SiteSetting.embed_truncate = true` and `topic.stubs(:has_topic_embed?).returns(true)` were moved into the nested `describe 'with an emeddable host'` block.
